info.title: API.SH: No Fluff Jobs
info.description: The No Fluff Jobs API from API.SH: public No Fluff Jobs data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The No Fluff Jobs salary calculator for Poland: for a job category and seniority (optionally a technology and location), the number of ads it is based on and the monthly salary distribution in PLN (lowest 1% and 10%, the market range at the chosen percentile, highest 10% and 1%) for employment contracts (gross) or B2B (net), plus the most requested technologies and the locations with ad counts. Without `category` it lists the categories.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/nofluffjobs-salary-report

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Job category, e.g. Backend, Frontend, DevOps, Data and BI, Testing, Marketing (leave out to list them).

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City or Remote / Non-remote as the site names them, e.g. Warsaw (default: all).

parameters.name: contract
parameters.description: b2b (net, default) or uop (employment contract, gross).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
IT job ads on No Fluff Jobs (Poland and Central Europe; every ad shows a salary range) with the site's filters: city, province, remote, category, skill, seniority, employment type, company, job language, minimum salary and region. Each result has the title, company, logo, category, main technology, seniority, salary range with contract type and period, locations with coordinates, work mode and dates. Pages follow the site; pass `next_page` back as `page`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/nofluffjobs-search

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Cities, comma separated (e.g. warszawa, krakow, wroclaw).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Categories, comma separated (backend, frontend, fullstack, mobile, devops, testing, data, ai, security, project-manager, business-analyst, ux, support, sys-administrator, ...).

parameters.name: skill
parameters.description: Required skills, comma separated (e.g. python, java, react).

parameters.name: seniority
parameters.description: Seniority levels, comma separated: trainee, junior, mid, senior, expert.

parameters.name: employment
parameters.description: Contract types, comma separated: permanent, b2b, zlecenie, uod, intern.

parameters.name: job_language
parameters.description: Language of the ad, comma separated (e.g. en, pl).

parameters.name: salary_period
parameters.description: Salary period for salary_min and the shown ranges.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: No Fluff Jobs similar job ads
get.description:
The job ads No Fluff Jobs shows as similar to one ad, with the total: each with id, title, link, company, logo, category, technology, seniority, salary range (from, to, currency, type, period), locations, remote and work mode, regions, tiles and posted and renewed times.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/nofluffjobs-similar-jobs

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Job id or slug, or a nofluffjobs.com job link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
